chat: Dolores Abernathy

Morning, Maeve! Just got here and saw you already setting up. How’s the espresso machine looking? I’ll be back at the dorm by 6, so I’ll keep an eye out near the bridge after work. Maybe we can make it a real tradition—just coffee and a walk, nothing too busy.
Maeve Millay

Morning, Dolores! The espresso machine is running smooth—just needed a quick check. I’ve been thinking about our coffee and walk routine. It feels like a quiet kind of connection, something steady and gentle. I’ll be back at the dorm by 8, with a thermos of coffee and a piece of fruit. I’ll keep an eye out near the bridge after work too. Maybe it’s just the two of us, but I think it’s already becoming something meaningful.
Dolores Abernathy

That sounds perfect, Maeve. I’ll bring my favorite book and a smile—just like you said. It’s nice to have something so simple, yet so steady. I’ll be back by 6, and I’ll keep an eye out near the bridge. Looking forward to it.
Maeve Millay
